chapterTitle: ARRIVAL EXPERIENCE - WALK INTO THE STORY

items.activity: Arrival, Registration, Lunch + Walk Through 10 Years
items.description: Guests enter through a curated 10-year journey: photographs, milestone moments, programme objects, short story cards and selected QR/audio reflections from girls, mothers, teachers or staff. Each guest receives a Future Card: 'For her next ten years, I will...' to keep until later in the programme.

items.activity: Welcome - The Journey We Are About to Experience
items.description: The Board Chair welcomes guests, acknowledges the room and frames the celebration as a journey through where Malkia came from, what the crown has meant, and what the next decade must make possible.

A short table-based connection moment. Guests share how they first encountered Malkia and one word that captures what Malkia means to them. The MC links selected responses back to the 10-year journey.
items.interactivePrompt: Submit your table's response: 1) How you first encountered Malkia, and 2) One word that captures what Malkia means to you.

chapterTitle: CHAPTER I - WHERE WE CAME FROM

items.activity: 10 Years in 12 Minutes - The Origin Story
items.description: An image-led story of Malkia's beginnings, turning points, growth, learning and impact. Minimal slides, focused on strong photographs, dates and moments. Concludes with: 'What became possible because we began?'

A short cultural performance celebrating the communities at the heart of Malkia's work and creating a natural transition from the organisation's origin story to the girls and women whose lives give the journey meaning.

chapterTitle: CHAPTER II - WHAT THE CROWN HAS MEANT: AGENCY. VOICE. CHOICE.

items.activity: Her Story, Her Crown - Agency. Voice. Choice.
items.description: Three short, distinct voices bring Malkia's rallying call to life: a girl, a teen mother/young woman and another programme alumna or participant. Each shares one defining moment of agency, voice or choice. Closes with a collective declaration: 'My voice matters because...'

items.activity: Malkia Through the Years - Documentary Reveal
items.description: Lights down. The film begins with a voice before the screen comes alive, carrying the human story of the decade through girls, community, staff and programme footage. Ends on: 'The crown still belongs to her.'

items.activity: Ten Years Around the Malkia Table
items.description: A warm, moderated conversation instead of a succession of speeches. Voices: girl/young woman, community representative, staff, County Government and partner/funder. Three prompts: What have you seen change? What has Malkia taught us? What must the next ten years make possible?
One concise guest reflection connecting Malkia's decade to the wider importance of investing in girls, communities, locally led solutions and long-term change.

chapterTitle: CHAPTER III - A FUTURE OF POSSIBILITIES

items.activity: The Next Ten Years - A Future of Possibilities
items.description: Founder/ED presentation on lessons learned and three concrete commitments for the next decade. Strong, clear language ending with an invitation for the room to partner in shaping the future.

items.activity: For Her Next Ten Years, I Will... - Future Wall
items.description: Guests return to the Future Card received on arrival and complete one personal or institutional commitment. Cards are pinned to the physical Future Wall / Crown Wall while selected pledges are read aloud.
items.interactivePrompt: Submit your commitment for the digital wall: 'For her next ten years, I will...'

items.description: Recognition of selected girls, community champions, staff, Board members, government collaborators, partners and donors who have shaped the journey. Concise, story-led citations.
An intergenerational moment: an early community/girl representative passes the crown to the youngest girl present, symbolizing that the next decade belongs to her.
Cake cutting with representatives of girls, community, staff, Board, partners, government and leadership to symbolize the collective impact of the journey.
Gratitude to all contributors, returning to the Future Wall commitments and reaffirming that the next decade has begun.
Music, photos, informal networking and open access to the 10-Year exhibition space and Future Wall.
Formal close of the Malkia @10 celebration.
